concept.title: Arts, crafts and making groups
concept.shortdesc: Taking part in hands-on creative groups such as arts and crafts, knitting, sewing and Lego or model building.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Hands-on building and making activities, mainly Lego clubs and Lego therapy, plus model and toy making.
: Taking part in arts, crafts, making and creative projects, including hobby workshops and workshops using tools.
: Groups, classes and sessions for knitting, crocheting, sewing and similar needlecraft, often social.
